### <span class="imp imp-high" title="Importance 7.5/10" aria-label="Importance 7.5 of 10">7.5</span> Anthropic shuts down hijacked accounts mining AI tokens with stolen credentials
Anthropic shut down a credential-theft campaign that used commodity infostealer malware to hijack user accounts and exploit their paid Claude API token usage. The attackers stole authenticated sessions and cookies to bypass multi-factor authentication, but the malware itself is unrelated to Claude.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>Infostealer malware targeted Claude users&#x27; credentials and session cookies</li>
<li>Attackers exploited victims&#x27; paid token quotas without authorization</li>
<li>Anthropic logged affected users out and removed saved payment methods</li>
<li>Malware is commodity tool, not Claude-specific threat</li>
</ul>

Sources: [The Register](https://www.theregister.com/security/2026/08/31/anthropic-cracks-down-on-hijacked-user-accounts-mining-ai-tokens/5293461) <span class="src-badge src-research">AI Web Searched</span>, [finance.biggo.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidkFVX3lxTE02ci02WjltNE5CWjkxMDRpLXhHNktjMjByQ21wQlcxdFIwc1FLcjU4bHM5eXRWeHlWTndWYkV0dTdYdEItcC04WnE2QUVmdzJ6MnA2M3VVQi1KdDRkSnllWnhYTWwwb2g5NjF3RHJPNFNvcnZrX2c?oc=5) <span class="src-badge src-rss">RSS</span>
